references.text: The burnt offering shall be a bull from the herd, a male without defect, presented at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting so that it may be acceptable to the Lord.
The burnt offering may also be from the flock, either sheep or goats, a male without defect.
Aaron brought forward an offering, including a calf for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, both without defect.
A one-year-old lamb shall be brought as a burnt offering, which corresponds to the requirement of a one-year-old lamb in the consecration offering.
On the day of the new moon, two young bulls, one ram, and seven one-year-old lambs shall be offered as a burnt offering to the Lord.
The burnt offering on the day of the Feast of Trumpets includes a young bull, one ram, and seven one-year-old lambs without defect.
The daily burnt offering consisted of one-year-old lambs, showing the central role of one-year-old animals in the sacrificial system.
